method.name: Scrimmage consistency
method.units: Percentage points above the measured FBS mean
method.definition: Opponent-adjusted net success rate on provider-covered plays; one weight per measured game
method.scope: Experimental scrimmage consistency, not complete team performance

priorProvenance.interpretation: General population context from a completed earlier season; no inherited individual-team effects

limitations: Experimental scrimmage consistency on provider-covered plays.
The original historical FBS–FCS forecast test remains recorded as failed; the recent-prior candidate has separate retrospective checks.
Success rate does not fully measure turnovers, special teams, short fields or overtime.
Withholding one game can materially change positions; close rankings carry uncertainty.
Scores describe measured efficiency and are not win probabilities.

validation.interpretation: The retained historical next-game diagnostic does not certify or invalidate every current descriptive ranking. Experimental display is authorized; further calibration remains research.

originalFailedForecastGate.scope: Repeated2023-2025 next-game forecast diagnostic for originalV2; retained unchanged

withheld.scope: As-of-publication descriptive leave-one-game-out; NOT a pregame forecast

reference.teamEffects: Current-season only; no inherited team ranking points
